name: Nitrazepam
aliases: mogadon, baronite, dormin, dreem, enzed, gentravit, hypnonex, hypnoril, hypnotex, konit, nicare, nigap, nipam, nirosun, nitavan, nithra
summary: Hypnotic benzodiazepine that is used for short-term relief of anxiety and insomnia. The drug is reported to cause CNS depression.

pharmacology.text: Nitrazepam is a nitrobenzodiazepine. It is a 1,4 benzodiazepine, with the chemical name 1,3-Dihydro-7-nitro-5-phenyl-2H-1,4- benzodiazepin-2-one. It is long acting, lipophilic, and metabolised hepatically by oxidative pathways. It acts on benzodiazepine receptors in the brain which are associated with the GABA receptors, causing an enhanced binding of GABA to GABAA receptors.

uses.text: Nitrazepam is used to treat short-term sleeping problems (insomnia), namely difficulty falling asleep, frequent awakening, early awakening, or a combination of each. Nitrazepam is sometimes tried to treat epilepsy when other medications fail. It has been found to be more effective than clonazepam in the treatment of West syndrome, which is an age-dependent epilepsy, affecting the very young.

summaryZh: 硝西泮（英語：Nitrazepam，商品名有Mogadon等）是一種有機化合物，分子式C15H11N3O3，屬於苯二氮䓬類藥物，可用作治療焦慮與失眠的安眠藥。
summaryZhHans: 硝西泮（英语：Nitrazepam，商品名有Mogadon等）是一种有机化合物，分子式C15H11N3O3，属于苯二氮䓬类药物，可用作治疗焦虑与失眠的安眠药。

sideEffects.en: Benzodiazepines cause drowsiness, poor coordination, slurred speech and memory gaps. Regular use leads to tolerance and dependence, and stopping suddenly after heavy use can cause seizures, which can be life threatening.
sideEffects.zh: 苯二氮平類會造成嗜睡、協調變差、口齒不清與記憶斷片。規律使用會產生耐受性與依賴，大量使用後突然停藥可能引發癲癇發作，甚至有生命危險。
sideEffects.zhHans: 苯二氮平类会造成嗜睡、协调制差、口齿不清与记忆断片。规律使用会产生耐受性与依赖，大量使用后突然停药可能引发癫痫发作，甚至有生命危险。

fact.en: Nitrazepam was patented by Roche in 1961 and was one of the first benzodiazepines to be sold as a sleeping tablet, under the name Mogadon.
fact.zh: 硝西泮由羅氏藥廠在 1961 年取得專利，是最早以安眠藥形式販售的苯二氮平類藥物之一，商品名為 Mogadon。
fact.zhHans: 硝西泮由罗氏药厂在 1961 年取得专利，是最早以安眠药形式贩售的苯二氮平类药物之一，商品名为 Mogadon。
